src/App.tsx:  const safeJsonParse = (text: string | undefined, fallback: any = []) => {
src/App.tsx:    if (!text) return fallback;
src/App.tsx:    const trimmed = text.trim();
src/App.tsx:    try {
src/App.tsx:      // Try direct parse first
src/App.tsx:      return JSON.parse(trimmed);
src/App.tsx:    } catch (e) {
src/App.tsx:      // Try to extract JSON from markdown code blocks
src/App.tsx:      const jsonMatch = trimmed.match(/```(?:json)?\s*([\s\S]*?)\s*```/);
src/App.tsx:      if (jsonMatch && jsonMatch[1]) {
src/App.tsx:        try {
src/App.tsx:          return JSON.parse(jsonMatch[1].trim());
src/App.tsx:        } catch (e2) {
src/App.tsx:          console.error("Failed to parse extracted JSON:", e2);
src/App.tsx:        }
src/App.tsx:      }
src/App.tsx:      
src/App.tsx:      // Try to find the first [ or { and the matching ] or }
src/App.tsx:      const firstBracket = trimmed.indexOf('[');
src/App.tsx:      const firstBrace = trimmed.indexOf('{');
src/App.tsx:      const start = (firstBracket !== -1 && (firstBrace === -1 || firstBracket < firstBrace)) ? firstBracket : firstBrace;
src/App.tsx:      
src/App.tsx:      if (start !== -1) {
src/App.tsx:        const char = trimmed[start];
src/App.tsx:        const endChar = char === '{' ? '}' : ']';
src/App.tsx:        let count = 0;
src/App.tsx:        let inString = false;
src/App.tsx:        let escaped = false;
src/App.tsx:        
src/App.tsx:        for (let i = start; i < trimmed.length; i++) {
src/App.tsx:          const c = trimmed[i];
src/App.tsx:          if (escaped) { escaped = false; continue; }
src/App.tsx:          if (c === '\\') { escaped = true; continue; }
src/App.tsx:          if (c === '"') { inString = !inString; continue; }
src/App.tsx:          if (!inString) {
src/App.tsx:            if (c === char) count++;
src/App.tsx:            else if (c === endChar) {
src/App.tsx:              count--;
src/App.tsx:              if (count === 0) {
src/App.tsx:                try {
src/App.tsx:                  return JSON.parse(trimmed.substring(start, i + 1));
src/App.tsx:                } catch (e3) {
src/App.tsx:                  console.error("Failed to parse balanced bracket JSON:", e3);
src/App.tsx:                }
src/App.tsx:              }
src/App.tsx:            }
src/App.tsx:          }
src/App.tsx:        }
src/App.tsx:
src/App.tsx:        // Fallback to last index if balanced matching fails
src/App.tsx:        const lastBracket = trimmed.lastIndexOf(']');
src/App.tsx:        const lastBrace = trimmed.lastIndexOf('}');
src/App.tsx:        const end = Math.max(lastBracket, lastBrace);
src/App.tsx:        
src/App.tsx:        if (end !== -1 && end > start) {
src/App.tsx:          try {
src/App.tsx:            return JSON.parse(trimmed.substring(start, end + 1).trim());
src/App.tsx:          } catch (e4) {
src/App.tsx:            // If it still fails, try to find the *first* valid JSON object by shrinking from the end
src/App.tsx:            let currentEnd = end;
src/App.tsx:            while (currentEnd > start) {
src/App.tsx:              const nextEnd = trimmed.lastIndexOf(endChar, currentEnd - 1);
src/App.tsx:              if (nextEnd === -1 || nextEnd <= start) break;
src/App.tsx:              try {
src/App.tsx:                return JSON.parse(trimmed.substring(start, nextEnd + 1).trim());
src/App.tsx:              } catch (e5) {
src/App.tsx:                currentEnd = nextEnd;
src/App.tsx:              }
src/App.tsx:            }
src/App.tsx:            console.error("Failed to parse bracket-extracted JSON:", e4);
src/App.tsx:          }
src/App.tsx:        }
src/App.tsx:      }
src/App.tsx:      
src/App.tsx:      console.error("All JSON parsing attempts failed for:", text);
src/App.tsx:      return fallback;
src/App.tsx:    }
